status: Frozen before searching for a new collection dataset in this turn
already_used: All 18 Depee2021 Part I Table 3 values. Also exclude datasets previously inspected in source/provenance records, including Depee2021 Part II and Hardy2023 evaporation work.
question: Does the unchanged falling_capture candidate predict previously unused neutral sodium-fluorescein collection measurements under matching documented conditions?
eligibility: Measured collection efficiencies, not another model output
Numerical table or raw data with droplet radius, wet aerosol radius, temperature, relative humidity and falling speed
Neutral or documented effectively uncharged particles and drops; no external electric field
Sodium fluorescein material (the frozen model hardcodes its thermal conductivity)
No use of response values to choose parameters or which eligible rows to keep
regime_reporting: Report Reynolds number and extrapolation. Creeping-flow Re>=0.1 cases are external stress tests, not validation of accuracy in a controlled small-Re domain.
pressure_rule: 101325 Pa is an assumption if pressure is unavailable; explicitly label a conditional comparison. Missing speed or humidity precludes a matched validation.
scores: four-seed sampling interval, distinct from measurement uncertainty
interpretation: No universal pass threshold or smoke-validation claim. Publish mismatches, excluded candidates and eligibility reasons. Any subsequent physical/model change makes these data development data for that new version.
limits: A local timestamp/hash is a documented freeze, not an independently registered preregistration. This is a retrospective literature test, not a blinded new experiment.
